messages.text:
The focused runs exposed two real mismatches before the verifier could pass: Windows text output was translating `\n` to `\r\n`, and the ZipCrypto shortcut produced false positives because one header byte is not enough to prove the password.

I’m fixing those boundaries now: force Unix newlines and verify classic ZIP encryption by actual decryption/CRC through Python’s standard zip reader.
